background: BNP Paribas is the largest bank in the eurozone, a universal bank with retail networks in France, Belgium, Italy and Luxembourg, a large corporate and investment bank, and consumer finance, leasing and asset management arms.
synthesis: Ratings are strong at A+ on average across all three main agencies, none of them lower and all three on a stable outlook; the last move was a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. The ratios, though, are on the weak side of EU and Nordic peers across the board: CET1 of 13.0% and leverage of 4.4% are both in the bottom quarter, and LCR of 135% and NSFR of 109% are likewise in the bottom quarter. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods. The flagged news is good, with a 33% jump in profit reported on 23 Jul 2026; scale and diversification, not ratio headroom, are what the ratings rest on.
